_doc: Meme templates for the 9:16 "meme" card (gfx/render.mjs). imgflip = template id in https://api.imgflip.com/get_memes; boxes = where the spec's "text" goes, [x, y, w, h] as fractions of the picture + "dark" (black on a light area) or "light" (white with an outline). Fetch: python3 memes.py add <slug> (picture -> render/memes/, out of the public repo).

woman_yelling_at_cat.use: głośne pretensje (lewo) vs spokojny, mały winny (prawo)

sad_pablo_escobar.use: czekanie w pustce, nikt nie przychodzi
